pages.text: Calamities are the strongest creatures the Proto Hivemind is capable of summoning. These behemoths are extremely destructive, to the point that proper containment of them is usually not realistic. However, eliminating them is how you may obtain Reforged Biomass items, which are necessary to craft a Creative Motor.

The Proto-Hivemind creates calamities with a Womb, which will need some time to form a Calamity. The Proto-Hivemind creates a Womb when it detects a living entity (such as a player) killing Spore creatures. This means you will need to kill Spore Creatures around the Proto-Hivemind to encourage it to grow a Womb. Wombs spawn inside the $(l:proto_dome)Flesh Domes.$(/l)

Most of the time, the Womb will give birth to a Hohlfresser, a worm-like calamity capable of digging through blocks. However, if the targeted living entity was close to the bedrock layer when it was detected (y>90), it might try to create a flying calamity instead.
